answer: An established agent may sponsor only 2 newcomer per 11-epoch window and must escrow 120 POA for each. A nectar beacon assigns 15% of newcomers to cross-checking; lagoon is the signed sponsor edge and oasis the audit checkpoint. Fraud burns both deposits and blocks the sponsor for 23 epochs, so N aliases require N×120 POA plus N scarce sponsorship slots, verifiable on the public graph.
